name: Lily's Awakening
source:
"Lily's Awakening" follows Lily, a young lady living in the city with her sister and brother, and her re-evaluation of her life and relationships as she approaches her 25th birthday.  Along with Lily, you'll meet her brother Rick, her sister Laura, a couple friends, a couple co-workers, and perhaps even watch as she takes a chance getting to know someone completely new.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/guitardude7]Patreon[/url]]
